_comment: Measured painted-line parking headings (degrees TRUE), used ONLY by static AIRCRAFT placement (GSE and infrastructure keep their own placement/orientation). pydcs does not expose the parking-slot heading, so static aircraft otherwise get a geometric guess. Where a field is listed here, its statics face the measured heading instead — exact facing with none of the AI-parked costs (no FPS hit, no map contacts, no pop-in). Fields not listed keep the geometric guess (nothing regresses).
_schema: map_key -> { airfield_name: VALUE }, where VALUE is either a NUMBER (one dominant heading for the whole field's majority apron) or an OBJECT { "default": <number>, "slots": { "<slot_name>": <heading>, ... } } for exact per-spot facing. Per-slot values win over default; default wins over the geometric guess. Slot names are the stable pydcs names (e.g. D15, A28) — read one in the Mission Editor on the parking-spot tooltip.
